messages:
Alex: FYI seeing a new failure mode from tool_y: responses are objects but with `value` instead of `result`. Validator throws `missing required property: result`. ~1.8% of fncall traffic last 20m.
Mei: Is this a tool-side schema change or older adapters sending legacy keys? Any customer hits?
Alex: Mostly from our search-suggest traffic (low quota). No customer errors reported yet but strict validator is marking it as reject which routes to degen and inflates retries. Logs: ```WARN validate: missing 'result' -> payload={'value':'...'} trace=bb33c```
Jamal: Hmm. We could add a translation layer that maps common legacy keys -> canonical ones. But that is effectively schema coercion.
Eve: If we do mapping, we must surface it in the response and in metrics. I don't want silent contract changes. Tagging is non-negotiable.
Mei: Proposal: implement a small field-mapper in fncall preprocess step with feature flag `fncall-field-map-v1`. Mapping rules: {"value" -> "result", "out" -> "result"}. Emit telemetry `tool_y.field_map_count` and header `X-Fncall-Mapped: value->result`.
Alex: Also persist a sampled raw payload for 0.5% of mapped hits for audit.
Jamal: Routing concern: mapping needs to happen before route selection so we don't mistakenly trigger degen or billing. The routing layer uses validator outcome.
Eve: Agree. Put mapper in routing preproc. Add unit tests for mapped + unmapped cases and ensure metrics increment.
Mei: Console UX: add a small badge on tool_y's route page showing mapping rate and example traces. Ops toggle to flip the feature flag.
Alex: Rollout plan: FF OFF -> enable 0.1% -> monitor (mapped_count, strict_rejects_downstream, avg_latency) -> 1% -> 10%. If mapped_count/total > 2% for 10m, auto-roll back.
Jamal: Add an alert: fire when mapped_count / total_calls > 0.5% sustained 5m during early rollout OR when any mapped sample fails QA checks.
Eve: One more: update billing attribution so mapped requests are billed under original model route, not degen, since mapping happens pre-route. Make sure we add route tag `mapped=true` for later accounting.
ci-bot: build RW/patch/13001 -> status=queued for canary
Alex: I logged tasks: RW-13001 (mapper PR), RW-13002 (telemetry sampling), RW-13003 (console card), RW-13004 (billing tag). I'll own 13001+13004.
Mei: I'll add the sampling helper and ensure we redact PII when storing samples.
Jamal: I'll update runbook with criteria for rollback and how to interpret mapped vs true failures.
Eve: Please include changelog entry in adapters docs noting legacy keys we support and encourage adapters to migrate.
ops-bot: ci-bot started canary build RW/patch/13001 -> env=canary -> status=started :rocket:
Alex: Drafting tests now. Will add a short note in thread with PR link.
Eve: Thanks — keep alerting to #eng-oncall for any sustained spike. :thumbsup:
